headline: Presidential order about continuing US nuclear cooperation with the European Atomic Energy Community (EURATOM).
what_it_does: This order deals with nuclear cooperation between the United States and EURATOM, the European group that oversees civilian nuclear energy among its member countries. Based on the title alone, it appears to set or extend the terms under which the US keeps sharing nuclear materials and technology with EURATOM. No summary was provided, so the exact details are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: US nuclear fuel and technology exporters
who_it_affects.how: Their ability to send nuclear materials and equipment to European countries in EURATOM may depend on this cooperation continuing.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that oversee nuclear exports
who_it_affects.how: They would follow the order's direction when approving nuclear exports to EURATOM countries.
